0022600162.text: The Washington Wizards come in 3-3 overall, 1-2 on the road, and on a one-game win streak, and they are without Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The Orlando Magic are 2-3 and 0-2 at home, and they are missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery) and Noah Penda (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Washington lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 136-131 loss in Orlando on March 12, 2026.
